headline: Kyrgyzstan expands fuel subsidies: ECO-93 gasoline added to the list
summary: The Kyrgyz cabinet amended the subsidy mechanism for importing and selling fuels. ECO-93 gasoline has been added to the products eligible for state support.
why: Fuel subsidies change retail fuel prices and the economics of importers and distributors, and they influence fiscal spending.
original_headline: В Кыргызстане расширили субсидирование топлива: в список добавили бензин ЭКО-93
